name: Refine specific academic and scientific text passages
description: Users asked for editing, polishing, or rewriting of specific academic and scientific texts, such as dissertations, research paper sections, and technical descriptions. The requests focused on improving clarity, grammar, and academic tone, often with constraints to preserve original meaning, LaTeX formatting, or specific word counts.
